<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’ll go back to Alsa Grayweather at some point in the future, but for now, I expect she would want me here.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Alsa Grayweather Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Alsa [[Grayweather]] is a high-ranking official within the [[Blackwatch|Blackwatch Guild]], serving as the right hand to the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]], [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]]. In this capacity, she acts as a primary aide and leader within the disciplined, regimented military organization. Beyond her professional role, she is the mother of [[Calder]] and [[Rojric]]. She is described as a woman of significant social standing, possessing an ancestral connection to the dawn of [[The Empire|the Empire]] and maintaining a residence in a wealthy district of the Capital. Physically, she is noted for her beauty and long brown hair, though she has also been seen with short gray hair. Alsa is characterized by her competence and decisiveness; she has commanded outposts, managed [[Guild]] projects, and demonstrated combat proficiency using both a saber and a musket. Despite her high status, she has faced periods of confinement ordered by the Emperor and has been subject to personal supervision by [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As the commander of the outpost and a member in good standing of the [[Blackwatch|Blackwatch Guild]], Alsa holds a position of [[Authority|authority]] where she gives orders to her subordinates. She is the right hand of the [[Blackwatch]] and serves as a stabilizing influence for [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]], being the only person capable of bringing them back to reason. In her personal life, she is the mother of [[Calder]] and acts as a guardian within her residence.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Alsa is the mother of [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]]. She also works under the personal supervision of [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]], a person she is uniquely capable of bringing back to reason.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Alsa is a Reader who possesses the skill to attempt to read the heart. Her combat repertoire includes using a sword, an Awakened saber, and a pistol, though she has also been known to use a musket as a club. Additionally, she carries seven [[Awakened iron]] spikes in her coat and spent nearly two years attempting to summon [[Elderspawn]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Of Sea and Shadow}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Alsa [[Grayweather]] is a Reader and the mother of [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c4">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 8</ref> A former worker for the [[Blackwatch]], she serves as the commander of the outpost and acts as the right hand of the [[Blackwatch|Blackwatch Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c4" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref> She is an armed combatant who utilizes a sword, an Awakened saber, and even a musket used as a club, while carrying seven [[Awakened iron]] spikes in her coat.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref> During an initial attack, she attempted to [[Read]] the heart and gave orders to the [[Blackwatch]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12" /> Residing in the same home as [[Calder]]'s guardian, she suggested that [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] would return soon and offered to accompany her son.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c13">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c15">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 15</ref> While [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] intends to return to her, Alsa remains under the personal supervision of [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] and has spent nearly two years attempting to summon [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c24">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c28">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Of Kings and Killers}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Alsa [[Grayweather]] carries both a saber and a pistol.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref> Upon identifying the group, she recognized them as citizens of the [[Imperial]] Palace.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" /> Furthermore, Alsa is a person whose actions would cause [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] pain if she were forced to kill [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’m surprised your father didn’t tell you. What did you think I did for the Blackwatch?”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“He takes after his father,” Alsa said flatly, resting her hand on the hilt of her own sword.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’ll go back to Alsa Grayweather at some point in the future, but for now, I expect she would want me here.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16" />}}
